ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-22-2009 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.
Petitioner Lisa J. Jackson was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor, Sean Harold Agee.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Sean John Durden.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-08-2009 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Lisa J. Jackson was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor.

The Court is unable to proceed with the proposed name change to the fact that the is no indication in the case file that the minor's father was given notice of today's hearing.

Good cause appearing, this matter is taken OFF CALENDAR. Petitioner was sent to the Access Center for assistance.
